name: One Iced Latte: Milk Song
source:
Idol baristas, Samurai baristas, VTubers baristas, Robot baristas! The Coffee War has taken over Tokyo! You are Ken Katsuki, a young master and the new manager of Milk Milk Coffee. Help sweet Moka win the Barista Cup! ☆

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4278150]Steam[/url]]
translation:
偶像咖啡师、武士咖啡师、VTuber咖啡师、机器人咖啡师！咖啡战争席卷了东京！你是Ken Katsuki，一位少爷，也是Milk Milk Coffee的新任经理。帮助甜蜜的摩卡赢得咖啡师杯！☆

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4278150]Steam[/url]]
